```
['build a complete API URL for Azure AI Studio chat completions with api_version query parameter', 'validate environment headers for Azure AI Studio authentication with api-key or Bearer token', 'transform Azure AI Studio chat messages by converting list content to strings while preserving images and audio', 'get list of supported OpenAI parameters for an Azure AI model filtering tool_choice and stop', 'retry Azure AI LLM API call on HTTP errors by dropping unsupported parameters from the request']
```

